freshness.name: Freshness
freshness.formula: 20 x fresh required non-reference datasets / required non-reference datasets

continuity.name: Longitudinal continuity
continuity.formula: 15 x (75% trend day coverage + 25% brief archive coverage over 90 days)

provenance.name: Flag provenance
provenance.formula: 20 x (60% flags with a source + 40% flags with a source URL)

source_coverage.name: Source coverage and diversity
source_coverage.formula: 20 x weighted registered coverage, effective diversity, collector health, and top-source concentration

schema.name: Schema and timestamp integrity
schema.formula: 10 x (50% article date completeness + 30% flag core fields + 20% explicit evidence dates)

forecast_accountability.name: Forecast accountability
forecast_accountability.formula: 15 x (60% graded/finalized + 20% real refutations present + 20% calibration sample gate passed)

limitations: This rates data fitness and accountability, not whether every analytical claim is true.
Source keys are collection buckets and may not represent independent publishers.
Missing explicit evidence dates reduce the score; pipeline last_seen is not treated as evidence freshness.
Calibration remains unrated until at least 30 graded outcomes include a real refutation.
